# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** eleven years old  <sub>[v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 c38 P50](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0050)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c3 P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and college student  <sub>[v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)</sub>; redheaded snippet  <sub>[v2 c4 P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a girl with a small, pointed chin, a nice nose, and big gray eyes. She has bright red hair that she usually wears streaming or in braids, though it was briefly dyed green and clipped short after an unfortunate attempt to dye it raven black. She is often described with shining eyes and a flushed, animated face.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c28 P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056)_

## Personality

Anne is highly imaginative, romantic, and talkative, often given to vivid daydreams and intense emotional expressiveness. She possesses strong passion and determination, proving to be fierce in both her loves and her rivalries. Though prone to impulsive and careless blunders, she is deeply responsible and quick to confess when she realizes she is in the wrong. She is warm-hearted, optimistic, and intensely loyal to her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c14 P60](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0060), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v1 c20 P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025), [v2 c2 P33](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0033), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004), [v2 c25 P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031), [v3 c27 P32](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0032)_

## History

Anne Shirley came to Green Gables in Avonlea as an eleven-year-old orphan and was taken in by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert. She made a bosom friend in Diana Barry and threw herself into her studies at Avonlea school, forming a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe. Under the guidance of Miss Stacy, Anne entered Queen's Academy to earn a teacher's license, sharing top honors with Gilbert. Although she planned to attend college, she chose to stay in Avonlea to care for Marilla and teach locally, during which time she helped found the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Later, she attended Redmond College in Kingsport alongside friends like Priscilla Grant and Philippa Gordon, living at Patty's Place and continuing her education while also teaching during breaks.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)_
